item.content:encoded:
VRChat is a 100% remote company, and this role can be done from anywhere.

The role

The Head of People leads VRChat’s lean People function, supporting a globally distributed, fully remote team. You will own the people programs that help managers and employees do their best work, from performance cycles to employee relations, and you will partner with leadership on how the company grows its team and culture.

What you will do

Lead the People function and team. Run performance calibration and support fair, consistent performance processes. Coach managers on feedback, growth and difficult conversations. Handle employee relations matters with care and consistency. Maintain leveling and compensation practices that stay fair across a distributed team. Own and improve onboarding so new hires ramp quickly in a remote environment.

What you bring

Experience leading People / HR work for globally distributed, remote teams. Strength across performance management, manager coaching, employee relations, leveling and compensation, and onboarding. The judgment to balance employee experience with business needs in a lean team.

Benefits

Work from anywhere. VRChat is a 100% remote company offering flexible working hours. Health benefits. 401K / Group RRSP. Stock options. Unlimited / flexible vacation. Paid parental leave.

About VRChat

VRChat is a social VR platform where users explore thousands of community-created worlds, meet people from everywhere, and express themselves through custom avatars. The company has raised $100M from investors including Makers Fund, Anthos Capital and HTC.

item.content:encoded:
VRChat is looking for a part-time Contract 2D Designer through the end of the year.

What you will do

Create storefront thumbnails and bundle graphics for the VRChat marketplace. Design marketing, social media and blog graphics. Produce in-app banners. Create in-world signage and textures used inside VRChat worlds and experiences.

What you bring

A portfolio showing your 2D design work. Strong skills in Photoshop, Illustrator and Figma. Experience designing for small sizes and for multiple formats and aspect ratios. The ability to match the VRChat brand look and adapt designs across storefront, marketing and in-product surfaces.

How to apply

Applications ask for your weekly availability and your hourly rate, alongside your portfolio.

About VRChat

VRChat is a social VR platform where users explore thousands of community-created worlds, meet people from everywhere, and express themselves through custom avatars. The company has raised $100M from investors including Makers Fund, Anthos Capital and HTC.
